rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In a notice dated 'दिनांक - 16.01.2026' under 'संगठन पर्व - 2024', the National Returning Officer, Dr. K. Laxman, announces the election of the National President ('आज मैं राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष के निर्वाचन प्रक्रिया की आधिकारिक घोषणा करता हूँ') with a schedule: the electoral college list at noon on 16 January 2026; nominations (2-4 p.m.), scrutiny (4-5 p.m.), withdrawal (5-6 p.m.) and his press statement (6.30 p.m.) on 19 January 2026; and 'आधिकारिक घोषणा / मतदान (यदि आवश्यक हो)' (official announcement / poll, if needed) at 11.30 a.m.-1.30 p.m. on 20 January 2026, at 6A Deendayal Upadhyay Marg, New Delhi.
